content.user_title: Track Colombian TI Research With CvLAC
content.value_statement: Doctoral researchers need recent TI news tied to verified papers and Colombian academic records. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to connect news, DOI metadata, CvLAC, GrupLAC, and Publindex evidence.
actual_capabilities: Finds recent technology news and links it to DOI, OpenAlex, or Crossref evidence.
Prioritizes Colombian and LATAM context when the user requests regional monitoring.
Guides CvLAC profile checks for Colombian authors with affiliation matching.
Adds GrupLAC and Publindex context when public official sources support it.
Produces traceable text and structured research summaries for doctoral review.
Marks unverified fields as null or not confirmed instead of inventing data.
limitations: CvLAC has no public API, so profile checks require careful web lookup.
Homonyms can prevent confident author matching without manual review.
Publindex applies only when the journal is Colombian or officially indexed.
The skill depends on current web access for news, profiles, and metadata.

use_cases.title: Monitor Doctoral Research Topics
use_cases.description: Track recent TI news and connect each item to papers, venues, and research gaps.

use_cases.title: Validate Colombian Author Context
use_cases.description: Check whether Colombian authors have matching CvLAC profiles, GrupLAC links, and public academic records.

use_cases.title: Prepare Technology Watch Briefs
use_cases.description: Build concise evidence briefs with DOI metadata, venue metrics, and Colombia-specific relevance.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Scan
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a simple Colombian TI monitoring request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Track recent Colombian TI news about generative AI in education. Link each item to verified papers when possible. Use Spanish.

prompt_templates.title: CvLAC Author Enrichment
prompt_templates.scenario: Add Colombian author profile checks to a topic scan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find recent research news about cybersecurity in Colombia. Enrich Colombian authors with CvLAC and GrupLAC only when matches are clear.

prompt_templates.title: Publindex Venue Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Focus on journals and national indexing context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review recent TI papers linked to Colombian journals. Include Publindex category, SJR context, DOI metadata, and confidence notes.

prompt_templates.title: Doctoral Evidence Matrix
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a deeper analysis for thesis planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a deep monitoring report on federated learning in health. Cover Colombia and LATAM, CvLAC evidence, doctoral questions, and method risks.

output_examples.input: Topic scan for LLMs in Colombian public services.
output_examples.output: A ranked brief with recent news, linked papers, venue quality, Colombian author context, and doctoral research gaps.

output_examples.input: Known DOI with possible Colombian coauthors.
output_examples.output: An author validation summary with affiliation evidence, CvLAC match status, GrupLAC notes, and confidence level.

output_examples.input: Technology watch for cybersecurity in critical infrastructure.
output_examples.output: A concise research watch report with DOI evidence, Publindex checks, venue metrics, and practical thesis questions.

best_practices: Give a clear topic, time window, region, and desired output language.
Treat CvLAC matches as valid only when name, affiliation, and area align.
Keep every metric tied to its source and mark uncertain fields as unconfirmed.
anti_patterns: Do not request mass scraping of CvLAC or extraction of personal identity numbers.
Do not assign a CvLAC profile by name alone when homonyms exist.
Do not treat news claims as scientific evidence without a paper or clear source.

faq.question: Does this skill replace a literature review?
faq.answer: No. It supports monitoring and evidence triage, but researchers must still review papers directly.

faq.question: Can it use CvLAC for foreign authors?
faq.answer: Usually no. CvLAC enrichment is designed for Colombian authors or users who request specific exceptions.

faq.question: What happens when a CvLAC match is ambiguous?
faq.answer: The skill should mark confidence as low, avoid assigning a profile, and explain the ambiguity.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. Current news, DOI metadata, CvLAC profiles, and Publindex checks require web access.

faq.question: Can it output both text and structured data?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents both narrative summaries and structured output aligned to its schema.
